name: Views Extra Exposed Form Blocks
description: A Views display type that lets an exposed form be embedded as a block.
project_description:
This module provides a Views display plugin which allows additional exposed form blocks to be shown, which can be overridden to differ from a main exposed form block.

 For example, this can be used to create a view which shows a page with one set of filters, and has a block shown on other parts of the site with differently-configured filters.

 One application of this is showing SearchAPI facets with their result counts and with JavaScript auto-updating on a search results page, but showing the same facets without those options in a block shown in a sitewide header.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 This module integrates with Search API and Facets 3.
